title: Bug: timeline multi-select right-click 'Remove Frames' only removes one frame
description: When multiple frames are selected in the timeline, right-clicking shows 'Remove Frame' (singular) which only removes one frame instead of all selected frames. The context menu should show 'Remove Frames' (plural) when a range is selected, and the action should remove all frames in the selectedFrameRange. The keyboard Delete/Backspace path was fixed in task 0701, but the context menu handler still calls the single-frame remove action regardless of selection.
